labs.name: Nebraska Public Health Environmental Laboratory (NPHEL, state lab)
accredited_for: Not on the DHHS list: EPA-certified state lab (per its own page)
labs.detail: Not on the DHHS certified-labs PDF because DHHS runs the certification program; the NPHEL page says the lab "is certified by the United States Environmental Protection Agency (U.S. EPA)" and is audited on site every three years. Phone shown is the sample-kit line; main laboratory (402) 471-2122.
labs.note: Order kits online (Private Citizen Water Test Kit Request Form) or by phone. The kit form says coliform samples must be collected and mailed the same day, Monday through Thursday, and samples more than 30 hours old will not be tested; unused kits not returned within 90 days are billed. The Nebraska Department of Water, Energy and Environment (DWEE) said in a November 18, 2024 notice that bacteria kits cost $17 and nitrate kits $16. NPHEL's posted Analyte/Price List is still headed "pricing effective 7/1/13 - 12/31/23" (it lists Colilert coliform/E. coli $15, nitrate/nitrite $16, arsenic $19, uranium $19), and its Total Water Quality (New Well) fee list totals $3,472. Call to confirm current prices. For home loans, NPHEL asks for at least one and preferably two weeks. For help reading private-well results, DWEE: (402) 471-4982.
labs.source_name: Nebraska DHHS: Public Health Environmental Lab page
labs.source_name_2: NPHEL Customer Service / Analyte-Price List page

labs.name: Central District Health Department
labs.note: Takes private-well samples. Its water testing page (fetched 2026-11-15) says to request a sample kit by calling the laboratory office at 308-385-5175 or emailing waterlab@cdhd.ne.gov, recommends testing private wells every year for coliform bacteria, and lists test costs of coliform $27.00 and nitrate, hardness, fluoride and pH $25.00 each. On the DHHS list it is certified only for coliform/E. coli, so ask whether the other tests are certified if you need certified results.
labs.source_name_2: Central District Health Department: Water Testing page (fetched 2026-11-15)

labs.name: Enviro Services Inc.

labs.note: We could not load this lab's own website on 2026-11-15, so no phone number, prices or homeowner services are shown. It is on the DHHS list and on the Southwest Nebraska Public Health Department's list of certified labs for well owners.

labs.name: Metropolitan Utilities District (as printed: "Metropolitan Utilities Districts")
labs.note: This is Omaha's public water and gas utility lab. The DHHS list does not say whether it accepts samples from private-well owners, and we found no primary source that says it does. Call first.

labs.name: Midwest Laboratories, Inc.
labs.note: DHHS marks this lab "(by reciprocity)". Its environmental testing page (fetched 2026-11-15) lists water packages including W4 (nitrate-nitrite nitrogen by EPA 353.2, total coliform, E. coli) at $38.50, W3 Water Quality (coliform, E. coli, nitrate, hardness, iron, manganese, sodium, fluoride, pH and more) at $82.00, and W5: FHA Loan (total coliform, fecal coliform, E. coli, nitrate, nitrite, lead) at $104.50, and says bacteria samples must be received within 24 hours of sampling. It accepts drop-off Monday through Friday, 8 am to 4 pm, at the Omaha address. Confirm which tests on a package are run under its Nebraska certification.

labs.name: American Agricultural Laboratory
labs.note: Its own website (fetched 2026-11-15) prints the address as 700 West D Street, McCook, and says the lab was acquired by Brookside Laboratories, Inc. on September 1, 2026; the DHHS list predates that, so ask whether its Nebraska certification is unchanged. Its water page lists a "Household Suitability" package (minerals, nitrate, iron, manganese, total coliform and E. coli) and a nitrate plus total coliform/E. coli "purity" package. We did not show its prices because the page does not pair each price clearly with a package.
